definitions.explanation: The area along the shore of a bay or gulf. Used both for domestic locations (like Tokyo Bay) and international contexts (like the Persian Gulf).

examples.japanese: {湾岸|わんがん}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: High-rise apartments have increased in the waterfront area.

examples.japanese: {湾岸|わんがん}⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1991⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。

⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{湾岸|わんがん}⟦エリア→エリア：10726_eria⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}み→進む：01225_susumu⟧、⟦{商業|しょうぎょう}→商業：09940_shougyou⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧やオフィスビル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{立|た}ち{並|なら}んで⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The Tokyo Bay waterfront area has undergone redevelopment, with commercial facilities and office buildings lining up.

notes:
USAGE:
In domestic Japanese contexts, {湾岸|わんがん} often refers to the Tokyo Bay waterfront area (⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{湾岸|わんがん}), known for its modern development. In international contexts, it frequently refers to the Persian Gulf (ペルシャ{湾岸|わんがん}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湾岸|わんがん}⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧: bay area, gulf region
- {湾岸|わんがん}⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧: Gulf War
- ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧{湾岸|わんがん}: Tokyo Bay waterfront
- {湾岸|わんがん}⟦エリア→エリア：10726_eria⟧: waterfront area
- {湾岸|わんがん}⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧: bayshore road/expressway
